profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. It operates a cloud storage and file-sharing platform that, per its own site, offers secure storage, file collaboration, synced team folders, and previews for more than 175 file types. The company describes a product called Dash, which it says helps users save time and organize company content in one place.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which the site describes as providing document summaries, team data handling, and sharing controls. The site also notes that Dropbox connects with external AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, and describes built-in AI summaries as coming soon.

Dropbox is publicly traded under the ticker DBX and files with the SEC under CIK 0001467623. Its most recently recorded annual revenue, from a 10-K filing for the period ending December 31, 2025, was $2,521,000,000. The site's held facts also note a registered MCP server, listed under the name ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, which is described as enabling users to search, browse, and read Dropbox files, find documents by name or content, and list folders.
